description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin and Juniper Order Ranger
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.
